name: com.nova.toon
description: Anime / subculture toon shading for characters, ported from lilToon (MIT, lilxyzw): two shadow layers with border and blur, shadow color textures, border color, light min / max limits (never too bright or too dark), rim light, backlight and an inverted-hull outline. Materials pick the shader "lilToon" in the Inspector; VRM characters (MToon) are converted to it automatically.
